title: Speaker-Invariant Representation Learning for Spoofing Detection via Gradient Reversal and A Variational Information Bottleneck
abstract: arXiv:2606.08678v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sophisticated generative speech technology can undermined the reliability of voice biometrics. While spoofing detection systems excel when assessed under in-domain conditions, generalisation to out-of-domain settings is often poor. In this paper, we show that such issues could be caused by speaker bias, where models learn individual voice traits rather than markers of manipulation or generation. We propose a teacher-student framework for speaker-invariant spoofing detection that disentangles identity without requiring speaker labels. We leverage a pre-trained speaker recognition teacher to guide a student model via a gradient reversal layer. To control the balance between suppressing cues related to voice identity with the preservation of those related to spoofing detection, we integrate a Variational Information Bottleneck. Evaluations across nine datasets show our model achieves a 25.7% relative reduction to the EER compared

translated_title: 基于梯度反转与变分信息瓶颈的说话人不变表征学习用于欺骗检测
translated_abstract: 先进的生成式语音技术可能会削弱声纹生物识别的可靠性。尽管欺骗检测系统在域内条件下评估时表现出色，但在域外环境下的泛化能力通常较差。在本文中，我们证明了这些问题可能是由说话人偏差引起的，即模型学习的是个人语音特征而非语音操纵或生成的标志。我们提出了一个用于说话人不变欺骗检测的师生框架，该框架无需说话人标签即可解耦身份信息。我们利用预训练的说话人识别教师模型，通过梯度反转层来指导学生模型。为了控制抑制与语音身份相关线索与保留与欺骗检测相关线索之间的平衡，我们集成了变分信息瓶颈。在九个数据集上的评估表明，我们的模型相比基线实现了等错误率（EER）相对降低25.7%。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合梯度反转与变分信息瓶颈的师生框架，无需说话人标签即可学习说话人不变的语音欺骗检测表征，在九个数据集上实现了EER相对降低25.7%。
